name: Boston Common
heritage: National Register of Historic Places contributing property; National Historic Landmark; National Register of Historic Places listed place
text: The Boston Common is a public park in downtown Boston, Massachusetts. It is the oldest city park in the United States. Boston Common covers 50 acres (20 ha) bounded by five major Boston streets: Tremont Street, Park Street, Beacon Street, Charles Street, and Boylston Street.

depictions.name: Boston Common
depictions.text: The Boston Common is a park located in Boston and the first public park in North America.
